name: smwmusic-fury-of-the-storm-fury-of-the-storm
title: Fury of the Storm - Fury of the Storm
description:
Weird titling schemes ftw
Fury of the Storm is the main level theme in the 4th Place WLDC2022 Entry, well, "Fury of the Storm". Will fit very cold mountainous environments, potentially ones that are final.

Song is not compatible with Starman, Yoshi, P-switches, Bonus End, Thunder, and Blarggs. Technically not compatible with Death either, but the Pizzicato Strings make it sound funny enough.

Credit is appreciated.
